answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 2494 Country: India Title: This is msutafa and i am working in KSA. i came to see that here the people are praying only 8 rakats for taraweeh and asking that there is no authentic hadeeth for 20 rakats. will you please help me in this matter by giving any notes and any lecture that this people can satisfy with that. Question: as salam alaikum, sir, this is msutafa and i am working in KSA. i came to see that here the people are praying only 8 rakats for taraweeh and asking that there is no authentic hadeeth for 20 rakats. will you please help me in this matter by giving any notes and any lecture that this people can satisfy with that. thanking you, Ma'as salama. Answer ID: 2494 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1082/1082=J) The taraweeh prayer is 20 rakat sunnah . For details, please see: Risala Taraweeh by Hazrat Maulana Habibur Rahman Azami. It is not right to say that the narration of 20 rakat does not exist, rather it is wrong to understand it only 8 rakat . According to all the imams taraweeh is 20 rakat. This is confirmed and agreed upon and the Ummah acted accordingly ever and everywhere. For details, see: Babut Taraweeh, Fatawa Darul Uloom Deoband, vol 4. There are many other books written on the topic, you should study them: ق فی الدر المختار: التراویح و ھی عشرون رکعۃ و ھو قول الجمھور و علیہ عمل الناس شرقاً و غرباً الخ، وقد ثبت علیکم بسنتی و سنۃ الخلفاء الراشدین المھدیین عضوا علیھا بالنواجذ کما رواہ ابوداود۔ Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
